data.name: Apple Faces Up
data.detailed_description:
1. Rewrite the words to alter the "laws" of the world.

The books in the library record every event that occurs within this room.

Use the knowledge you have acquired to rewrite the words in the text—alter gravity, manipulate scale, and forge a path to the sealed exit.

2. Read the books and uncover the knowledge hidden within the library.

The library holds countless volumes detailing physical phenomena, history, and a wide array of trivia.

By reading and grasping the meaning of new words, you will expand the vocabulary available to you for rewriting.

Take your time reading the books one by one, enjoying the scattered knowledge and records as you unravel the mysteries awaiting you across the 13 rooms.

3. Your Watchful Guide, Librarian Mimir

Mimir, the librarian of the Infinite Library, serves as your guide, leading you toward the exit.

But why exactly is she observing a human take on these trials?

As you progress deeper through the rooms, the hidden motives behind both the library and Mimir herself will gradually come to light.

data.short_description: Alter the inscribed laws and unravel mysteries with knowledge and wisdom. Welcome to the Infinite Library, where all past, present, and future phenomena are recorded. As the one with the power to rewrite these books, you must face 13 trials bestowed by the angel Mimir.
